newsitem.title: USA: CMG Info says Freemark suspends free email.
newsitem.headline: CMG Info says Freemark suspends free email.

text.p: CMG Information Services Inc said on Tuesday its Freemark Communications Inc portfolio company suspended all operations of its free email service, because it was unable to raise enough equity capital.
Freemark was not able to raise sufficient equity capital to further its sales and marketing campaign and aggressively pursue the required growth in its subscriber base, CMG said.
CMG@Vantures, as lead investor, was not in a position to continue the funding requirements without significant investment from other sources, CMG said.
A group of Freemark investors was pursuing various financing options, including the sale of the business or the sale of the subscriber base, CMG said.
CMG said it was actively involved in negotiations with a potential buyer.
The company also said any potential pre-tax charge in the second quarter for its investment in Freemark was not expected to be material to CMG's consolidated financial statement.
